answer: No agent docks at the wharf of the trusted set for free. A newcomer starts on a bare knoll of near-zero weight and earns standing only as independent peers attest its honest work over many epochs, through a refundable stake bond that unlocks slowly. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. Real reputation is hard to forge as carved ivory; no clever claim mints it in bulk.
